item.title: Modern authentication in ASP.NET Core with 2FA and passkey
item.description: This walkthrough builds a .NET 10 ASP.NET Core Web API (TwoFaNET10) implementing two-factor authentication and WebAuthn/FIDO2 passkey login, using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore with Npgsql PostgreSQL, JWT bearer tokens, and a custom ApplicationUser extending IdentityUser. Link to article: https://blog.elmah.io/modern-authentication-in-asp-net-ore-with-2fa-and-passkey/
